title: Rubrik Releases Next Season of Acclaimed “To Catch a Thief” by Nicole Perlroth, Podcast Documentary Details Current Threats from North Korea
summary: The bestselling author and cybersecurity expert exposes alarming truths about the global network of North Korean operatives who have infiltrated Western payrolls Rubrik FORWARD — Rubrik (NYSE: RBRK), the Security and AI Operations Company, announced the launch of season two of its award-winning documentary podcast, "To Catch a Thief: North Koreans On Our Payroll." Based on exclusive reporting by Nicole Perlroth, bestselling author and former lead cybersecurity reporter for The New York Times , the series exposes a global labor pipeline infiltrated by North Korea—one that is quietly funneling hundreds of millions of dollars a year back to the regime, and its nuclear weapons program. Reported over the last year, “To Catch a Thief” builds on the success of season one about Chinese hacking, which became a top five Apple documentary podcast.
